workarounds.symptom: image_url: non-dict value raises, dropped detail not logged
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve explicit image detail in Responses requests. Target files: agentao/llm/_openai_responses.py, tests/test_openai_responses_adapter.py, CHANGELOG.md. The Responses adapter omitted explicit image detail preferences when translating Chat-shaped history. Preserve the supported `low`, `high`, `auto` and `original` values in outbound `input_image` items through a strict allowlist. Read the image payload once and leave stored history unchanged. Unsupported or absent values retain their previous omission behavior. (Ref: https://github.com/jin-bo/agentao/pull/608)
